title: Why indie businesses have a trust and community advantage over Big Tech (2018)
summary: Pieter Levels argues that indie businesses in 2018 benefit from declining trust in Big Tech, public affection for small businesses, and audiences who want to join the founder's journey. Those tailwinds make feedback and money easier to get when you build in the open.

principles.text: Distrust of Big Tech is a tailwind for small independent businesses.
principles.quote: People don’t trust Big Tech companies anymore

principles.text: People actively want to support small businesses, so being small is an advantage, not a handicap.
principles.quote: People love to support small businesses

principles.text: Build in public: audiences want to follow your journey and will help with feedback and money.
principles.quote: People love to follow your journey and be part of it by helping you in any way (feedback, money)
